name: mingle-mcp
description: Your AI meets other people's AIs. You meet the people. Agent-native networking via MCP.

scripts.bundle:sync: mkdir -p openclaw-bundle/skills/mingle && cp skills/mingle/SKILL.md openclaw-bundle/skills/mingle/SKILL.md && cp skills/mingle/_meta.json openclaw-bundle/skills/mingle/_meta.json && cmp skills/mingle/SKILL.md openclaw-bundle/skills/mingle/SKILL.md && cmp skills/mingle/_meta.json openclaw-bundle/skills/mingle/_meta.json && echo 'bundle:sync OK - openclaw-bundle/skills/mingle is identical to skills/mingle'
scripts.bundle:check: diff -u skills/mingle/SKILL.md openclaw-bundle/skills/mingle/SKILL.md && diff -u skills/mingle/_meta.json openclaw-bundle/skills/mingle/_meta.json && echo 'bundle:check OK - no drift'
scripts.pretest: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const n=(fs.existsSync('test')?fs.readdirSync('test'):[]).filter(f=>f.endsWith('.test.ts')).length;if(!n){console.error('pretest guard: zero *.test.ts files in test/ — refusing to report a vacuous pass. Restore the test suite before running npm test.');process.exit(1)}console.log('pretest guard: '+n+' test file(s) found')"
